title: Beyond Detection: Exploring Evidence-based Multi-Agent Debate for Misinformation Intervention and Persuasion
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks measure the accuracy of misinformation detection and the persuasive effect of AI-generated explanations on general topics.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research.
